title: HPE expects memory shortages to last into 2028 as networking takes on a bigger profit role
html: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) expects the tight supply of memory and other components that lifted its server prices this year to persist well beyond the coming fiscal year, a shift management says will squeeze margins in its largest segment and put more of...
